تختتنوا (form VIII)
# تَخْتَتِنُوا (taḵtatinū) /tax.ta.ti.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَتَنَ (iḵtatana)
# تُخْتَتَنُوا (tuḵtatanū) /tux.ta.ta.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَتَنَ (iḵtatana)
